scope: Production hooks, webPlatform and components in jsdom. Distinct Platform instances model open windows; localStorage is one jsdom realm. No independent browser process, native durability, layout, OS notification or latency certification.

observations.name: notification_corrupt_browser_read
observations.limitation: Content helper is exercised; no actual OS notification is delivered.

observations.name: notification_rejected_read_control
observations.limitation: Injected generic platform rejection, not Electron IPC.

observations.name: notification_cross_window_lost_private_choice
observations.limitation: Sequential writes and a simulated browser storage event in one DOM realm; actual independent tabs still need acceptance.

observations.name: notification_open_window_stale_privacy
observations.limitation: Production hook and browser event in jsdom, not native notification deduplication.

observations.name: notification_trusted_alias_scope
observations.classification: new confirmed behavior needing privacy-policy decision
observations.limitation: Authentic address-trust/storage helpers with synthetic identity; no live alias navigation. Settings UI says workspace/device, while preference key uses address/user.

observations.name: same_draft_conflict_policy
observations.limitation: Production DraftPersistence, serialized sharedDevice test double, not native Electron or independent browser processes.

observations.name: fresh_send_acceptance_before_storage
observations.limitation: Held serialized storage test double and pending API; proves clear precedes acknowledgement, not actual process-death loss.
